text: I am Dr. Agent. You presented with sudden-onset lower abdominal pain; to begin my assessment, please describe the exact location of the pain and how severe it is on a scale of 1 to 10. Additionally, have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, fever, or changes in bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Epididymitis (likely bacterial given unprotected sex) vs. Testicular Torsion (given sudden onset during activity).
